description: Revenue and conversion stats: totals, order counts, bump/upsell take rates, plus by_offer and by_project rollups. Offers with a multi-step post-purchase funnel also carry per-step rows in by_offer[].steps (position, kind, shown, accepted, take_rate, revenue_cents). Cart offers' by_offer rows also carry items[] with per-item attach rates (times shown vs bought, revenue per line) — the proof a cart raises AOV. Pass `project` to scope everything to one project — the answer to 'how did iGloo do this week?'.
